response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_of_media_averages FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.Name AS media_type_name, ma.avg_bytes_per_ms, ma.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.avg_of_media_averages AS above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ma.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.avg_of_media_averages

assumptions.assumption: Passing the file-size cutoff means exceeding 10,323,804 bytes.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is a maximum allowed size, include tracks of 10,323,804 bytes or less.
